en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front shows a black and white photograph of a serene landscape featuring a wooden cabin, trees, a river, and a bridge in the distance. There is handwritten text at the bottom, and printed text reading 'Utsikt från Tuna till Attmar, 1902.' Attribution is given to photographer Hildur Björklind of Sundsvall/Matfors. The reverse side has printed and handwritten Swedish text, postal markings from Göteborg and Sundsvall, a green stamp labeled 'Sverge' (Sweden), and it is addressed to a person in Göteborg.
